metadata.question: Did the burn scar area near Hermit Park in Santa Fe, New Mexico (35.759, 105.503), increase between April 19, 2022, and April 23, 2022?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about burn scar area change near Hermit Park in Santa Fe, New Mexico between April 19, 2022 and April 23, 2022. This is a 4-day period, which is quite short for burn scar analysis. For burn scar detection, I should use: 1. NBR (Normalized Burn Ratio) = (NIR - SWIR) / (NIR + SWIR) 2. dNBR (differenced NBR) = pre-fire NBR - post-fire NBR 3. Higher dNBR values indicate more severe burning I'll use Landsat 8/9 since they have the necessary SWIR bands and good temporal resolution. Approach: 1. Define point geometry and create a buffer (5km radius) 2. Get Landsat 8/9 imagery for both dates with cloud masking 3. Calculate NBR for both images 4. Calculate dNBR and count pixels above burn threshold 5. Check if burn area increased I need to be careful about: - Cloud masking (crucial for accurate analysis) - Valid pixel counts - Handling the short time period - Defining a reasonable dNBR threshold for burn detection (typically >0.1 indicates burn) Let me structure the code accordingly. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const point = ee.Geometry.Point([-105.503, 35.759]); const aoi = point.buffer(5000); // 5km buffer around Hermit Park const date1 = '2022-04-19'; const date2 = '2022-04-23'; // 2. Cloud masking function for Landsat function maskL8sr(image) { const cloudShadowBitMask = 1 << 3; const cloudsBitMask = 1 << 5; const qa = image.select('QA_PIXEL'); const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudShadowBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudsBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } // 3. Data Acquisition - Try Landsat 8/9 function getLandsatCollection(startDate, endDate) { const l8 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(aoi) .map(maskL8sr); const l9 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(aoi) .map(maskL8sr); return l8.merge(l9); } // Get collections for both dates (3-day window for each) const col1 = getLandsatCollection('2022-04-18', '2022-04-20'); const col2 = getLandsatCollection('2022-04-22', '2022-04-24'); const size1 = col1.size().getInfo(); const size2 = col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`April 19 Images: ${size1}, April 23 Images: ${size2}`); if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 4. Get median composites and calculate NBR function calculateNBR(image) { const nbr = image.normalizedDifference(['SR_B5', 'SR_B7']).rename('NBR'); return image.addBands(nbr); } const img1 = calculateNBR(col1.median()); const img2 = calculateNBR(col2.median()); // 5. Calculate dNBR (difference in NBR) const dnbr = img1.select('NBR').subtract(img2.select('NBR')).rename('dNBR'); // 6. Count burn pixels (dNBR > 0.1 indicates burn) const burnThreshold = 0.1; const burnMask = dnbr.gt(burnThreshold); // Count pixels in each category const stats = burnMask.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.frequencyHistogram(), geometry: aoi, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const hist = stats.get('dNBR').getInfo(); const burnPixels = hist && hist['1'] ? hist['1'] : 0; const nonBurnPixels = hist && hist['0'] ? hist['0'] : 0; const totalPixels = burnPixels + nonBurnPixels; console.log(`Burn pixels: ${burnPixels}, Non-burn: ${nonBurnPixels}, Total: ${totalPixels}`); if (totalPixels === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // 7. Calculate burn area percentage const burnPercent = (burnPixels / totalPixels) * 100; console.log(`Burn area: ${burnPercent.toFixed(2)}%`); // 8. Determine if burn scar increased (any burn pixels detected) if (burnPixels > 0) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
